question: The gateway security fix is merged. What should happen next, and can we close the finding?

alternatives.title: Close at merge
alternatives.tradeoff: The completed ticket cannot establish production treatment. The affected version is still serving.

alternatives.title: Defer until after launch
alternatives.tradeoff: Avoids rollout disruption now but leaves the observed exposure. No interim treatment or acceptance is established.

challenge.title: Are we mistaking completion for an outcome?
challenge.body: A ticket, a merge and a deployment answer different questions. The customer configuration also needs to keep working.
challenge.check: Bind the scoped security and sign-in checks to the deployed artifact.

advice.title: Merge is a start. Verify the fix in production.
advice.reason: The ticket is done, but the affected gateway is still serving traffic. Plan the approved rollout and test the actual customer sign-in path.
advice.condition: Nora must resolve the change window and rollback check. Closure is unsupported until the scoped security check passes on every serving replica.
advice.next: Nora: confirm the window, rollout and verification owner.
advice.support: The production version decides this next step. A completed ticket repeats the patch review and adds no independent confirmation.

stages.label: Add deployment receipt

advice.title: Deployed. Keep the finding open.
advice.reason: The build identity now matches the fix on all three replicas. We still need the security check and the customer sign-in check on this deployment.
advice.condition: Suri must verify SEC-142 against D-281. Missing change-approval evidence remains a separate follow-up.
advice.next: Suri: run the scoped security and sign-in checks.
advice.support: Deployment answers where the code runs. It does not answer whether the treatment worked.

stages.change: D-281 establishes deployment of B-281; it does not establish verification.

stages.label: Add successful verification

advice.title: Propose closure for this finding.
advice.reason: The fixed artifact is deployed and the scoped security and sign-in checks pass. Suri can review closure of SEC-142 for gw-prod-eu.
advice.condition: Closure is a proposal for this finding only. Resolve the missing CHG-87 approval record separately; future drift is not monitored by this demo.
advice.next: Suri: review V-281 and record the scoped closure decision.
advice.support: The observed deployment and independent check support this proposal; they do not prove security outside the tested scope.

stages.change: V-281 supplies the missing outcome check. The earlier completed ticket was insufficient.

stages.label: Try failed verification

advice.title: The treatment broke required work.
advice.reason: Valid customer sign-in fails. Keep SEC-142 open and ask Nora to resolve the regression under the release process.
advice.condition: Rollback is only requested. Reverting restores the vulnerable version, so a revised treatment or authorised interim arrangement is needed.
advice.next: Nora and Suri: review rollback and the remaining exposure.
advice.support: A passed signature check cannot compensate for a failed required workflow.

stages.change: The relevant sign-in test failed; the next step changes even though the patch is deployed.
stages.status: Deployed · required workflow failed · finding open

stages.label: Add rollback receipt

advice.title: Recovered service. Unresolved exposure.
advice.reason: The rollback restores sign-in and the affected artifact. Re-plan treatment of SEC-142 with the service and security owners.
advice.condition: No safeguard, accepted exception or successful security retest is established for 2.8.0.
advice.next: Nora and Suri: agree a revised fix and scoped verification.
advice.support: The later artifact observation supersedes the earlier deployment for current state.

stages.change: D-280-R shows the affected version serving again. Prior verification cannot close a reverted deployment.

finding@finding / r1.claim: The production gateway accepts an invalid session.
finding@finding / r1.quote: SEC-142: A controlled check on gateway 2.8.0 accepted a session without the required signature check on /session/restore. Treatment: deploy 2.8.1 and repeat that check on all serving replicas.
finding@finding / r1.why: Establishes a specific exposure and a verifiable treatment.
finding@finding / r1.limit: Fictional finding, not a real advisory. Other endpoints and environments were not tested.

change-policy@change-policy / v2.label: Release conditions
change-policy@change-policy / v2.claim: Deployment needs an approved window and a rollback path.
change-policy@change-policy / v2.quote: CHG-4: Gateway releases need the service owner’s approval, a demonstrated rollback path and post-deployment verification bound to the release artifact.
change-policy@change-policy / v2.why: These are conditions, not weights other inputs can outweigh.
change-policy@change-policy / v2.limit: This policy is not approval for PR-87. The approval record is absent.

record.subject: CHG-4 v2
record.checked: Prepared observation: 28 September 2026. No current refresh.

capacity@capacity / r1.why: Makes a controlled rollout feasible without treating the deadline as permission.
capacity@capacity / r1.limit: Attributed availability is not an approved change window or accepted risk.

verification@verification / r1.label: Scoped security check
verification@verification / r1.claim: The signature check passes on the deployed artifact.
verification@verification / r1.quote: V-281: At 10:25, replicas a,b,c reported gw:2.8.1. Invalid signatures were denied on /session/restore; valid acme-eu sign-in succeeded. Suri, security reviewer, recorded the probes and responses.
verification@verification / r1.why: Supports proposed closure for SEC-142 in this exact scope.
verification@verification / r1.limit: Does not cover other endpoints or future rollbacks. Closure still needs the accountable reviewer; this test cannot supply missing change approval.

record.checked: Prepared observation: 30 September 2026 · 10:25. No current refresh.

verification-failed@verification-failed.label: Failed sign-in check
verification-failed@verification-failed.claim: The security check passes, but customer sign-in fails.
verification-failed@verification-failed.quote: Alternative V-281-F: On B-281 in gw-prod-eu, invalid signatures are denied; valid acme-eu sessions fail. Rollback has been requested, not observed.
verification-failed@verification-failed.why: The treatment breaks required work. Resolve or roll back under the release process and retain the security exposure if reverting.
verification-failed@verification-failed.limit: A rollback request is not a rollback receipt. The old artifact would remain affected.

rollback@rollback / r1.why: Reopens the treatment question instead of treating service recovery as security closure.
rollback@rollback / r1.limit: Operational recovery is not mitigation of SEC-142.

sourceFamilies.question: What finding or review actually needs a decision?
sourceFamilies.limit: Workflow status is not verified treatment or approval.

sourceFamilies.question: Which immutable account belongs to which custodian?
sourceFamilies.limit: Names and employment do not establish permissions.
sourceFamilies.coverage: Not used: service/artifact case, no person-account join needed.

sourceFamilies.question: What can the exact account or service do, including inherited grants?
sourceFamilies.limit: A role catalogue is not a test of effective rights.
sourceFamilies.coverage: Not used: no access change evaluated.

sourceFamilies.question: What happened in the observed window and what coverage is missing?
sourceFamilies.limit: No observed event is not proof of no activity or no need.

sourceFamilies.question: Which change produced which artifact?
sourceFamilies.limit: A merge or component match is not production treatment.

sourceFamilies.question: What ran, and what exact outcome was independently checked?
sourceFamilies.limit: Implementation does not establish effective treatment or authority.

sourceFamilies.question: What requirement, boundary, approval and validity apply?
sourceFamilies.limit: A request or runbook does not implement or authorise a safeguard.

sourceFamilies.question: Who owns the treatment and which dependencies remain?
sourceFamilies.limit: A done ticket does not prove verification or delivery authority.

sourceFamilies.question: Which earlier incident or review makes a check relevant?
sourceFamilies.limit: Past similarity does not predict the new outcome.

sourceFamilies.question: Which attributed work or delivery constraint affects the choice?
sourceFamilies.limit: A date or statement does not grant approval or make an obligation mandatory.
